concepts.def: Light from screens that delays sleep

walkthroughs.body_html:
Teens need 8–10 hours a night.

Most UK teens get less — and it shows in grades and mood.

Common culprits:

  • Phones — blue light keeps brain awake.
  • Caffeine in late cola.
  • Late, heavy meals.
  • Random bedtimes.

Pro tips:

  • Same bedtime daily — even weekends.
  • Phone away 30+ min before sleep.
  • Cool, dark room.
  • Power naps under 20 min.

Catch up on sleep debt when you can. 😴
